name: Kraken
lore: The Reach's deterrent. It launches from under the water: a boil on the surface, then cruise missiles that run in low over sea and shore, so only close-in guns get a shot, and late. Every launch paints the boat for everyone listening.

weapons.name: Heavy Torpedo Tubes
weapons.lore: Eight bow tubes, fired four at a time.

weapons.name: Cruise Missiles
weapons.lore: Four hatches behind the sail. Each missile boosts clear of the water, unfolds its wings and skims in under 25 m; one whose mark dies finds another.
